enchantments.tooltip: Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Regeneration: Causes the wearer to regenerate 1 hit point a minute using positive energy.

Improved Quelling Strikes: On Vorpal Melee: applies a Quell effect to target enemy for six seconds, rendering them unable to cast divine spells. This has a 50% chance of preventing the target from casting all spells for three seconds (12 second cooldown).
Insightful Magical Sheltering +4: +4 Insight bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
